queries_run: BorgWarner go-to-market OR business model shift OR channel 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：汽車產品一般直接賣給 OEM，依年度合約或長期供應協議，直接從工廠出貨；未見通路／商業模式結構性轉變（訂閱、D2C）描述。
findings.excerpt: The Company’s automotive products are generally sold directly to OEMs, substantially pursuant to negotiated annual contracts, long-term supply agreements or terms and conditions as may be modified by the parties. Deliveries are subject to periodic authorizations based upon OEM production schedules. The Company typically ships its products directly from its plants to the OEMs.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 僅 1 次搜尋，未見通路轉移來源；搜尋摘要提及退出充電業務屬產品組合調整，非通路轉移，未列為 finding。
